why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Install a Xian wallet Add the Xian Wallet Chrome extension or the Android wallet .
2 Step 2 : Open the Xian airdrop site Go to the Xian Airdrop site and continue from the GitHub Developer Airdrop card.
3 Step 3 : Connect your Xian wallet Choose Connect Wallet under the Connect Xian Wallet heading and connect your Xian wallet.
4 Step 4 : Connect your GitHub account Choose Connect GitHub on the same page and link your GitHub account.
5 Step 5 : Claim the airdrop Submit the claim on the airdrop site once both connections are in place.
